SELECT 
  f.date,
  f.forecast_units_per_day AS forecast,
  d.units_sold AS actual,
  (d.units_sold - f.forecast_units_per_day) AS deviation
FROM store.forecasts f
JOIN store.daily_sales d ON f.date = d.date AND f.sku = d.sku
WHERE f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND f.date >= '2026-06-01' AND f.date <= '2026-06-30'
ORDER BY f.date;

SELECT 
  AVG(ABS(d.units_sold - f.forecast_units_per_day)) AS mae,
  AVG(ABS(d.units_sold - f.forecast_units_per_day) / NULLIF(d.units_sold,0)) * 100 AS mape,
  COUNT(*) AS days_forecast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.units_sold = 0) AS days_out_of_stock
FROM store.forecasts f
JOIN store.daily_sales d ON f.date = d.date AND f.sku = d.sku
WHERE f.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND f.date >= '2026-06-01' AND f.date <= '2026-06-30';
